title: Sources: Ant International is considering raising ~$1B at a $10B+ valuation, which could help pave the way for a potential Hong Kong IPO as soon as 2026 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Ant International is considering raising ~$1B at a $10B+ valuation, which could help pave the way for a potential Hong Kong IPO as soon as 2026 — Ant Group Co.'s international business is considering raising about $1 billion to accelerate growth, according to people familiar with the situation.
